description: Defines the HostCache class used for DNS hostname resolution caching, including nested classes for cache keys, entries, staleness info, and interfaces for persistence. Contains method declarations for cache operations, serialization, and testing utilities.

classes.name: net::HostCache
classes.description: A cache for hostname resolution results, mapping hostnames to their resolved IP addresses and related metadata.

classes.name: net::HostCache::Key
classes.description: Represents a unique key for cache entries, including hostname, DNS query type, resolver flags, source, and security.

classes.name: net::HostCache::Entry
classes.description: Stores DNS resolution results, including IP addresses, errors, TTL, and metadata.

classes.name: net::HostCache::EntryStaleness
classes.description: Indicates how stale a cache entry is, based on expiration and network changes.

classes.name: net::HostCache::PersistenceDelegate
classes.description: Interface for persistent storage interactions for the cache.

methods.name: HostCache::Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a valid cache entry for a given key at a specific time.

methods.name: HostCache::Set
methods.description: Stores or updates a cache entry for a given key.

methods.name: HostCache::Invalidate
methods.description: Marks all cache entries as stale due to network change.
